free_tier.stated: no free tier. Four paid plans with a monthly Credit quota: Lite USD 6 a month (list USD 8) for 11,500 Credits, Essential USD 10 (list USD 16) for 25,500, Standard USD 18 (list USD 25) for 45,000 and Pro USD 68 (list USD 80) for 180,000. A Credit Pack adds 20,000 Credits for USD 15 a month
free_tier.notes: the unit is the vendor's Credit; the Credits that one request costs depend on model type, token usage, thinking mode and tool calls. The lower prices are marked limited-time, and the vendor may change promotions

interface_detail: OpenAI-compatible base URL https://token-plan.maas.qwencloudapi.com/compatible-mode/v1 and Anthropic-compatible base URL https://token-plan.maas.qwencloudapi.com/apps/anthropic, with a plan key that starts with sk-sp-. Text models include qwen3.8-max, qwen3.7-plus, glm-5.3 and deepseek-v4-pro, and the plan also covers image, speech and video models. Harness tools run only through the Responses API and cost Credits per successful call
tooling: any tool that accepts a custom base URL and key and speaks the OpenAI or Anthropic protocol; the vendor names Claude Code, Cursor, Qwen Code, Codex, Qoder and OpenClaw, and Qwen Code offers the plan under QwenCloud in its auth menu
chaining: the plan key replaces the pay-as-you-go key inside a coding client; an exhausted quota blocks calls and does not bill pay-as-you-go, so a key recorded under inference continues the work until the next subscription month

limits.value: Lite 11,500 Credits a month, Essential 25,500, Standard 45,000, Pro 180,000; no weekly cap; calls are blocked when the quota and any Credit Pack are used up, until the next subscription month; unused quota does not carry over
a Credit Pack gives 20,000 Credits for USD 15 a month, needs an active subscription, is valid for 1 month, and up to 5 packs can be held at a time
recommended concurrency of 1-2 agents on Lite, 2-3 on Essential, 3-4 on Standard and 6-8 on Pro; rate limits adjust to load and cannot be raised, and peak hours can queue requests

limits_note: the quota unit is the vendor's Credit and not a byte, so volume-quota is the nearest term; the plan is sold and used only in the Singapore region with global deployment, and one account holds one Personal Edition subscription
binding_note: the monthly Credit quota ends use before any rate limit, and the Credits that a request costs grow with model, context length and thinking mode

identity_cost.detail: A QwenCloud account is made with a GitHub login or an email address with an emailed verification code, and it is an Alibaba Cloud international main account. QwenCloud takes payment with a card, PayPal, Google Pay or Apple Pay plus billing details: a name, an address and a mobile number that receives a verification code. Linking a card places a USD 1.00 pre-authorization, and one card or wallet links to one account. What the Token Plan checkout asks beyond these fields: unverified: behind a sign-up

reliability_note: a plan with no Credits left blocks calls until the next subscription month; peak hours can queue requests; a key used for scripts or batch calls can be suspended; the plan has no cancellation or refund; the limited-time prices can change
confidence_note: prices, quotas, base URLs and account rules are quoted from the vendor documentation read on 2026-11-02. The quotas are the vendor's published numbers and are not a measurement. Token Plan checkout fields are unverified: behind a sign-up
